action: Open Analysis hub and select a multi-chart layout option
response: Chart area splits into multiple charts
result: Multi-chart on MOBILE exists
notes: KEY FINDING: App v2.120.0 (2025-11-15) 'Added new options for a multi-layout mode in the Analysis hub menu on the Chart screen.' CONTRADICTS the common claim that multi-chart is desktop-only. Charts per tab: Basic 1, Essential 2, Plus 4, Premium 8, Ultimate 16 - whether mobile honours 16 is unverified.

action: Understand what a layout stores
result: Stores charts (1-16), chart settings, chart type, interval, symbol, indicators, drawings. Does NOT store watchlists or alerts
notes: This separation is exactly WHY the mobile watchlist is a peer tab rather than part of the chart: watchlists and alerts are account-scoped, layouts are workspace-scoped.

action: Enable Autosave
result: Drawings and changes save instantly and propagate to other tabs/devices in REAL TIME
persist: With autosave OFF, objects sync only once after a manual save
notes: THIS IS THE ANSWER TO 'why does the workspace travel with the user.' Objects sync between windows/tabs/devices in real time ONLY when layout autosave is enabled. Whether iOS exposes this toggle, or autosaves implicitly, is UNVERIFIED and is the most important open question in this lane.

action: Choose the drawing's sync scope
response: Three modes: Disabled (this chart only), By layout, Global (all charts and layouts)
result: Drawings can follow the user across every layout and device
notes: DESTRUCTIVE EDGE: 'switching modes will remove it from all other layouts' / 'Disabling global sync will delete all drawings for that symbol from other layouts.' A single toggle can silently wipe drawings account-wide. Mobile availability unverified.

action: Save or apply an indicator template
result: Indicator sets reusable across symbols and layouts (indicators are NOT synced between layouts otherwise)
notes: Official warning: applying an indicator template REMOVES drawing objects that live in indicator panes.

action: Launch the app
response: Chart screen shows the LAST CHART VIEWED including one opened in the web browser or Desktop app
result: Cross-device continuity by default
notes: THIS is the mechanism behind the 'workspace travels with me' feeling - and also a common complaint, because desktop activity hijacks what the phone opens.

target: Remember last opened chart on this device
action: Enable device-scoped chart memory
result: App shows the last chart viewed ON THIS DEVICE instead of the cross-device last chart
notes: A whole help article exists purely to let users OPT OUT of cross-device continuity - strong evidence the default is a real pain point.

target: Main chart selection from a desktop grid
action: Open a desktop multi-chart layout on the phone
response: The TOP-LEFT chart of the desktop grid is shown as the main chart
result: Graceful degradation of a desktop grid to a phone
notes: Published TV idea by a community author. May now be superseded by native multi-layout mode on mobile (v2.120.0). Flag as possibly STALE.

action: Change anything
result: Chart layouts, indicators, watchlists, alerts and user settings all live server-side and propagate across web, desktop and iOS/Android
notes: Secondary source. The individual mechanisms are each officially documented; the aggregate claim is the inference.

action: Exceed the layout count
result: Basic 1, Essential 5, Plus 10; Premium and Ultimate higher/unlimited
notes: Premium/Ultimate values not extractable from fetched markup; a 2026 secondary source reports Unlimited. NEEDS VISUAL CONFIRMATION.

action: Long-press the price scale
result: Faster access to scale/appearance settings without opening the hub
notes: App v2.138.0-2.139.0. NOTE the collision with the older 'long-press price scale for a quick alert' pattern described by third parties - one of these is now stale.

action: Tap the left-pointing undo arrow at the top of the chart
result: Reverts drawings, removed indicators, and chart settings changes
persist: Undone state is autosaved if autosave is on
notes: WEAKEST-EVIDENCE ROW IN THE LANE. Undo/redo arrows well documented on web/desktop. Multiple YouTube tutorials 'How to Undo and Redo in TradingView App on Phone' (one updated 2026-06-03) strongly imply mobile undo exists - but no transcript or official mobile doc could be retrieved. TradingView's help center has NO undo/redo article at all, for any platform.

action: Tap the right-pointing redo arrow
result: Redo
notes: Existence of a phone-specific undo/redo tutorial video is the evidence; the video itself could not be fetched.

action: Determine what is undoable
result: Drawings (create/move/delete), indicator removal, chart settings ARE undoable. Symbol changes, layout deletion, alert deletion and watchlist symbol removal are NOT documented as undoable
persist: Undo history is session-scoped and shallow
notes: Official recovery article positions undo as an immediate-only remedy: 'Click it immediately after the accidental removal.' Deep history is not guaranteed.

action: Tap undo with a broker connected and live positions on chart
response: Positions and orders are treated as user drawings and are DELETED; redo does not restore them
result: Data-loss-adjacent defect
notes: Filed against the TV Charting LIBRARY, NOT the first-party iOS app. Do not assume it reproduces - but the app and library share charting lineage, so worth probing.

target: Trash icon in drawing action bar
action: Tap trash with a drawing selected
result: Single-drawing removal with NO confirmation dialog
notes: Lock is the preventive control; undo is the corrective one.

action: Lock a drawing
result: Prevents accidental-gesture destruction on a touch screen
notes: Locking matters far more on mobile than desktop because fat-finger drags on a phone are the dominant accidental-modification vector.

action: Bulk-remove all drawings and/or indicators
result: Full chart reset
persist: Autosaved if autosave is on - which makes this CROSS-DEVICE destructive
notes: The official article documents NO confirmation dialog. With autosave on and global drawing sync enabled, this can propagate destruction to every device and every layout.

action: Hide rather than delete
result: Non-destructive alternative to Remove
persist: Visibility state saved in the layout
notes: A dedicated help article exists for restoring hidden objects, implying users routinely confuse Hide with Remove.

action: Delete an alert
response: Confirmation prompt reported on mobile ('tap the X, press yes to delete')
result: Alert removed permanently
persist: No undo; the alert must be recreated
notes: Notably MORE protective than layout deletion, which is far more destructive.

action: Reset the chart view
response: Chart returns to the default visible range
result: Recovery from an accidental pinch or fling
persist: View state may be saved with the layout
notes: A 2024 mobile guide mentions a gear-icon 'reset price scale' option. Whether double-tap-to-reset exists on iOS is unverified.

action: Tap the slider icon at the bottom of the chart
response: A menu opens containing Bar Replay
result: BAR REPLAY EXISTS ON THE iOS APP - it is NOT desktop-only
notes: DEFINITIVE. Three independent confirmations: (1) App Store description lists 'Bar Replay'; (2) TV help article 'How to select replay interval for the Bar Replay IN MOBILE APPS'; (3) release notes v2.119.3 and v2.137.0 ship Bar Replay changes to the Chart screen.

action: Select Bar Replay
response: Replay panel appears; chart enters start-bar selection mode
result: Replay armed
notes: Two taps to arm replay on mobile vs one on desktop (top-toolbar button).

action: Tap the bar where the replay should begin
response: Chart truncates to that bar; future bars hidden
result: Replay ready to play from the chosen point
notes: Desktop uses a hover crosshair with a scissors cursor; mobile has no hover so tap-to-place is the substitute. Precision on a phone is a likely usability weak point.

action: Jump to the earliest bar in the chart's history
response: Replay positioned at the oldest available bar
result: Full-history replay without manual scrolling
notes: App v2.119.3 (2025-11-11) explicitly: 'First available day option in Bar Replay.' A MOBILE-SPECIFIC release note - genuinely first-class mobile feature, not a port.

action: Jump to a random historical bar
result: Bias-free practice sessions
notes: Documented platform-wide; mobile presence unverified. Given 'First available day' shipped to mobile, 'Random bar' probably did too.

action: Start or stop automatic bar advancement
response: Bars stream forward one replay-interval at a time
result: Automated playback
notes: Desktop shortcut Shift+Down. Mobile control layout inferred from the documented replay panel.

action: Advance exactly one bar
result: Bar-by-bar manual study
notes: Desktop shortcut Shift+Right. On mobile this becomes the PRIMARY interaction since there is no keyboard - expect heavy repeated tapping.

action: Change playback speed before or during playback
result: Faster or slower replay
notes: Official: the interval indicator sits 'next to the replay speed indicator', confirming speed and interval are adjacent controls.

action: Tap the currently displayed interval on the replay panel
response: Menu of available replay intervals opens
result: Replay granularity changed independently of chart interval
notes: THE ONLY OFFICIAL MOBILE-SPECIFIC BAR REPLAY DOC. Minimums: second charts 1s; intraday and daily 1 minute; weekly/monthly only in 1-day steps.

action: Let the app choose the replay interval
response: Interval set to the chart's own interval, or largest common interval in multi-chart
result: Removes a configuration step on a small screen
notes: App v2.137.0 (2026-08-04). Explicitly a Chart screen / mobile change and only a month old - freshest evidence in this lane.

action: Draw or read indicators during replay
response: Indicators recompute on replayed data; drawings annotate historical bars
result: Full analysis works inside replay; drawings persist after replay closes
notes: EXCEPTIONS: Regression Trend and Fixed Range Volume Profile do not function during replay. Strategies DO backtest against replayed data.

action: Attempt to create a server-side alert while in replay
result: NEW ALERTS CANNOT BE CREATED IN REPLAY MODE; existing alerts fire only on real-time data
notes: KEY CROSS-LANE INTERACTION: Bar Replay and Alerts are mutually exclusive. Also blocks generating trading orders.

action: Return to live data
response: Chart snaps back to the current bar
result: Live chart restored
persist: Replay session auto-saved for later continuation
notes: Alternative exits: close the panel via X, or tap the Bar Replay entry again to toggle off.

action: Re-enter Bar Replay after a previous session
response: Popup with two buttons: Continue or Start new
result: Restores symbols, intervals, time of last viewed bar, and replay state. Chart TYPE and STYLE are NOT restored
notes: Shipped 2025-10-06. Blog does not say whether mobile got it. If it did, it turns Bar Replay into a genuinely resumable mobile practice tool. UNRESOLVED.

action: Attempt Bar Replay on Renko/Kagi/PnF/Range/Line Break/Volume footprint/TPO, a spread symbol, or a currency-converted chart
response: The replay panel does not appear
result: SILENT FAILURE with no explanatory message
notes: A whole help article exists BECAUSE the failure is silent - a real UX defect, and worse on mobile where the button may be buried in a menu.

target: Synchronized Bar Replay across a multi-chart layout
action: Run replay across all charts at the same historical instant
result: Multi-timeframe replay
persist: Session restore covers only compatible charts
notes: Shipped July 2024 platform-wide. Now potentially reachable on mobile given multi-layout mode arrived Nov 2025 - but this COMBINATION is UNVERIFIED and would be high-value to test.

action: Place simulated orders inside replay
response: Replay trading panel with P&L, trade count and equity curve
result: Manual backtesting
notes: A help article for DISABLING executions confirms the feature. The Premium+ gate comes from a third-party 2026 source, NOT the pricing page. Mobile availability unverified - likely the weakest mobile replay area.

action: Attempt Bar Replay on a free account
result: Pricing page 'Bar Replay' row: Basic no; Essential/Plus/Premium/Ultimate yes
notes: NUANCE: third-party 2026 sources say Basic users can still replay DAILY and higher timeframes, with only INTRADAY replay gated to Essential+. The pricing row reads as a hard no. Also gated by intraday history depth. 1-second replay bars exist only from 2022-08-17.
